steps.text: A progressive wave transfers energy without transferring matter.
v = fλ for all waves; speed is set by the medium, not the frequency.
Transverse waves vibrate perpendicular to travel (light, water); longitudinal vibrate parallel (sound).
Particles oscillate about fixed positions; only the wave pattern moves.
Phase difference = 2π × (path difference / λ); one wavelength = 2π radians.
Doppler shift: moving source changes observed frequency, not wave speed.
